games.name: [READ DESC] Rojutsu Blox
games.desc:
This game is current in open testing phase! Expect bugs!

Controls:
- !Party = create party
- !invite USER = invite user to party
- !accept USER = accept party
- !decline = decline party
- !disband = disband party
- !remove USER = remove player from party
- M = Open Menu
- E (Level 5+) = Cursed Mana Aura(DMG Buff)
- X = Evade (If you have enough Mana while being hit)
- M2 = Block
- M1 = Combat
- Left Ctrl = Run/Walk
- Q = Dash

Having trouble finding your way around? Open the menu, go to options, and turn on the map key!

Boss spawn every 5 minutes!

Curses current in game:
- Limitless
- Dagger
- Fist
- Clap
- Speech
- Katana
- Vessel
- Flame
- Plant
- Blood

games.name: MINGLE [SQUID GAME 2] [✨ALL ROLES]
games.desc:
Welcome to the ORIGINAL Roblox MINGLE.

- The carousel will spin as the music plays.
- When the music stops, a number will be announced.
- Fill a room with exactly that number of players.
- If there are more or less players in a room when the timer runs out, all players in that room will be eliminated.
- Players who fail to enter a room before the timer runs out will also be eliminated.

UPDATE January 5th:
+ Guards
+ Stats

Inspired by SQUID GAME SEASON 2's Merry-go-Round / Carousel Game

(This Mingle experience became viral the day after season 2 came out!)
